title: ENGINEER - QA/QC
description:
****Job Title:****
**Surveyor – Civil**
**Entity:** 
 Bureau Veritas India Pvt Ltd (BVIL)
   

  

**Location:** 
 Kochi
   

  

**Reports to (job): Manager – B\&I, Kerala \& Coimbatore**
**Ø** 
**Purpose of Position**
* The job incumbent is responsible for performing QAQC inspections, audits, supervision as per QAP, approved procedure, standards, etc., Carries out some tasks independently, with minimum supervision, and these may be on well identified or isolated assets.
* Major Responsibilities
* Third Party Inspection or QA/QC of Civil Projects on a continuous basis
* Conducting on\-site training for juniors,
* Preparing progress report, field inspection report, NCs, etc based on client’s requirement.
* Follow up the above reports and close the gaps mentioned in the reports

* To comply company HSE requirements e.g. policies, Procedures, guidelines etc. and local legal requirements on HSE as applicable
* To take care of own health and safety as well as colleagues and others.
* Immediate reporting of any shortcomings on HSE i.e. any incident, unsafe work practices / conditions to his/her immediate Line Managers.
* Sharing opportunities for improvement on HSE aspects
* Criteria for Performance Evaluation (KPIs)
* On\-time delivery of Reports
* Client relationship – Retention and Growth.
* Compliance of internal and external guidelines, policies, procedures.
* Internal and external customer service satisfaction (e.g. number of complaints)
* To adhere Group HSE Guidelines.
* Qualification and Experience


****General:****
* Graduate Engineer BE/ B.Tech (Civil) with min. 6 to 8 years or Diploma with 8\-10 years of relevant experience.


****Technical:****
* Knowledge of QA/QC will be preferred.
* Skills \& Qualities:
* Good communication skills verbal, writing and presentation.
* Ability to comprehend technical issues quickly.
* Ability to work in a team.


**The Job Description is subject to change from time to time, as per the requirements**
**of the Company and the competencies / qualifications you may acquire in future.**

title: Tech S And T Product Engineer-Ardoq-NGTO-Senior-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Title** 
 \- Product Engineer \- Ardoq
   

  

**Experience** 
 : 3 to 7 years
   

  

**Employment Type** 
 : Full\-time
   

  

**Role Summary:**
 We are looking for a Product Engineer – Ardoq to develop, configure, integrate, and enhance Ardoq\-based enterprise architecture solutions. The role combines Ardoq platform engineering, Python development, API integrations, data engineering, and AI\-enabled analysis.The candidate will work with Enterprise Architects, Product Owners, Solution Architects, and technology teams to automate data ingestion, improve architecture data quality, and generate actionable insights from enterprise information.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Configure and maintain Ardoq workspaces, metamodels, components, references, fields, views, surveys, and permissions.
* Model applications, business capabilities, technologies, integrations, data flows, risks, and technical debt.
* Develop Python utilities and services for data ingestion, transformation, validation, enrichment, and synchronization.
* Integrate Ardoq with systems such as ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub, SharePoint, Azure, AWS, and other enterprise platforms.
* Build and maintain REST API integrations using JSON, HTTPS, authentication tokens, and service accounts.
* Apply AI and Large Language Models to analyze enterprise data, identify technical debt, classify findings, summarize issues, and generate recommendations.
* Develop and maintain AI prompts, response schemas, validation rules, and guardrails.
* Implement scheduled imports, data mappings, reconciliation, error handling, logging, and monitoring.
* Create Ardoq dashboards, visualizations, reports, and stakeholder\-specific architecture views.
* Support application portfolio management, technology lifecycle management, capability mapping, and application rationalization.
* Investigate and resolve integration, platform, access, AI\-output, and data\-quality issues.
* Prepare technical designs, integration specifications, operational runbooks, and user documentation.


**Must\-Have Skills:**
* 3 to 7 years of experience in product engineering, enterprise architecture tooling, integration development, or platform engineering.
* Hands\-on experience of Ardoq workspaces, metamodels, components, references, fields, visualizations, surveys, and integrations.
* Strong Python programming skills, including API clients, data processing, automation, and error handling.
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON, HTTPS, OAuth 2\.0, API tokens, and integration troubleshooting.
* Experience with AI services such as Azure OpenAI or equivalent enterprise LLM platforms.
* Knowledge of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, embeddings, vector search, AI agents, and prompt evaluation.
* Experience with Python frameworks and libraries such as FastAPI, Pydantic, Pandas, and Pytest.
* Experience with data transformation, validation, mapping, synchronization, and reconciliation.
* Understanding of business, application, data, integration, and technology architecture.
* Practical knowledge of AI and LLM concepts, including prompt engineering, structured outputs, grounding, and response validation.
* Experience using Git and standard software\-development practices such as code reviews, testing, and version control.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.


**Nice\-to\-Have Skills:**
* Experience integrating Ardoq with ServiceNow CMDB, Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub, SharePoint, Azure, or AWS.
* Knowledge of PostgreSQL, SQL, data modelling, and database integration.
* Experience with Application Portfolio Management and Technology Portfolio Management.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, and cloud\-native application deployment.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Experience with Postman, Swagger, OpenAPI, Power BI, and API\-management platforms.
* Exposure to technical debt assessment, technology risk, lifecycle tracking, and application rationalization.
* Familiarity with Ardoq ShiftX and business process modelling.


**Education:**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.
   

  

**Certifications(Added Advantage):**
* Ardoq Academy or Ardoq Partner certification
* Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

 As an SAP TM Technical expert, you will be responsible for leading the technical architecture, development and integration of SAP Transportation Management within S/4HANA or standalone TM. * Collaborate with Functional counterpart and cross module team(s) for targeted outcomes
* Adhere to standard best practices for code and deadlines by ensuring quality deliverables
* Provide technical guidance and support for SAP TM\-related projects
* Conduct system testing and user training to ensure effective utilization of SAP TM
* Monitor system performance and make necessary adjustments to improve efficiency
* Stay updated on the latest SAP TM features and best practices
* Good communication skills as the job require a high degree of verbal and written communication

* 4\-5 years of experience in implementation, support and upgrade projects in SAP TM
* Must have worked in one or more E2E implementation, integration, testing and application support in S/4HANA embedded TM and SAP TM (latest versions)

* Must be expert in BOPF framework along with consumer implementation and Enhancement workbench
* Should be having deep knowledge in SAP TM architecture, frameworks, enhancement points and BAdIs
* Should have expertise in Business Objects Node elements such as Determination, Action, Validation etc. along with logic building around Business Object instance modification, Charge Management frameworks and Strategies
* Strong ALE/IDoc experience and CPI/PI integration concepts
* Nice to have knowledge in Fiori/UI5, OData, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, RESTful services, CDS, AMDP, and data modelling in S/4HANA, RISE with SAP, Cloud ALM, TM extensibility using SAP BTP, RAP model, and Cloud SDK wherever applicable
* Proven ability to lead technical workstreams
* Actively pursuing continuous learning to constantly update skills and adhering to current standards in the industry

**The Opportunity**
 The SAP TM Transportation Management Senior Consultant serves as a senior\-level advisor responsible for leading complex SAP Transportation Management (TM) transformation initiatives for enterprise clients. This role combines deep SAP TM expertise with strategic consulting capabilities to design, implement, and optimize end\-to\-end transportation solutions that drive operational excellence, cost reduction, and supply chain visibility. The consultant participates in pursuing client sales opportunities and working on bid \& proposal efforts along with activities including configuration and setting up the SAP TM system, assessment of client business problems, conducting the analysis to solve the problems, administration of engagement activities while contributing to practice growth and innovation.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Responsible for the successful delivery of the SAP TM module related deliverables in SAP and S4 HANA implementation, support, and upgrade projects to meet engagement objectives and budget
* Lead design workshops with the client and responsible for requirement gathering, solution design, fit\-gap analysis, writing functional specification, system configuration, testing and cutover activities for both standalone SAP TM system and embedded SAP TM in S/4 HANA
* Design SAP TM system Integrations with other modules of SAP/S4 HANA (like EWM, SD, MM etc.) and 3rd Party system
* Provide functional and business process expertise to the project team, resolve TM related client s issues and mentor junior team members
* Handle various industry specific complex TM scenarios like shipper, LSP and carriers
* Work with sales team, write proposals, define SAP TM scope and effort estimation for the new opportunities and present SAP TM capability to the potential client


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Technical and Professional Requirements:**
* 5\-7 years of experience in implementation, support and upgrade projects in SAP TM.
* Must have good functional and business knowledge, worked in multiple E2E implementations, integration, testing and application support in S/4HANA embedded TM and SAP TM (latest versions)
* Ability to interact with other cross functional teams from modules like OTC, EWM for integration scenario
* Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills for co\-ordinating across teams
* Should be able to lead workshop or working sessions with business
* Knowledge in ABAP and debugging would be nice to have


**Core SAP TM Competencies**
* Comprehensive knowledge in all L3 aspects of SAP TM such as Order Management (Logistics Integration, Freight Unit, Forwarding Order, Freight Order, Freight Booking), Transportation Planning and Execution, Carrier Selection, Charge Calculation and Freight Settlement, Invoice Integration and Carrier Communication methodologies
* Proficiency in Master Data setup such as Resource Management, Locations, Business Partners etc.
* Deep understanding of SAP TM integration with SAP ERP S/4HANA logistics (SD, MM, LE) and embedded TM scenarios
* Expertise in Transportation Planning strategies: manual planning, Transportation Cockpit, optimizer\-based planning (VSR), and automated freight unit building
* Proficiency in Freight Order Lifecycle Management, Freight Tendering processes, Subcontracting and Execution monitoring
* Advanced knowledge of Charge calculation, Freight Agreement Management, Rate tables and Transportation cost allocation


**Technical Skills**
* SAP TM configuration and customizing across all functional areas (master data, organizational structures, profiles setup for Planning, business rules such as BRF\+ conditions)
* Data migration methodologies using DRF, LSMW, SAP Data Services, or Migration Cockpit; system landscape design (Development, Quality, Production)
* Understanding of SAP TM on HANA optimization, performance tuning, and analytics capabilities
* Expertise in implementation planning, fit\-gap analysis, SAP TM system configuration E2E, testing, rollout and post\-implementation support


**Industry Knowledge**
* Expertise in logistics and supply chain operations across multiple transportation modes (road, rail, ocean, air, intermodal)
* Knowledge of carrier management practices, freight procurement, contract negotiations, and service level agreements

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Test Automation Development:** 
 Design, develop and maintain automated test suites in Python using pytest and Selenium, and keyword\-driven suites in Robot Framework. Identify automation candidates within existing manual regression packs and convert them into reliable, reusable, data\-driven tests.
* **Framework Maintenance \& Code Quality:** 
 Extend shared automation libraries, page objects, custom keywords and test utilities. Participate in peer code reviews and keep suites maintainable, deterministic and free of flaky tests.
* **Regression \& Release Testing:** 
 Set up test environments and tools, then execute automated and manual regression cycles for official releases, verifying core functionality across supported platforms and configurations.
* **Test Environment Support:** 
 Deploy, configure and troubleshoot test environments on Linux, including Docker\-based and Kubernetes\-based deployments, and manage test data and environment configuration.
* **Defect Analysis \& Root Cause Investigation:** 
 Reproduce, isolate and troubleshoot defects using application logs, Linux tooling and monitoring dashboards. Perform root cause analysis, collaborate with developers on resolution, and log actionable, well\-evidenced bug reports.
* **Run Monitoring \& Reporting:** 
 Monitor scheduled and overnight automated runs, triage failures, track latency issues and application health checks, and deliver clear execution reports covering both manual and automated results.
* **Collaboration \& Process Improvement:** 
 Work with developers, QA colleagues and stakeholders to clarify requirements, review test coverage, and continuously refine testing workflows and engineering efficiency.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 



* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience as a QA Engineer, with proven expertise in both manual and automated testing.
* Strong proficiency in Python for test automation development (modules, OOP, standard libraries).
* Hands\-on experience with pytest and Selenium WebDriver for building and executing automated suites.
* Proven experience in designing, setting up and executing manual and automated regression suites and analysing test results.
* Experience with Git (branching, merge requests, code reviews) and CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins or GitLab CI for triggering automated suites.
* Strong command of Linux for test execution, log analysis and troubleshooting (shell, grep/awk, services, processes)
* Experience with Jira (issue and defect tracking) and Confluence (documentation).
* Strong defect investigation skills (ability to identify, reproduce, analyse root causes and report issues).
* Clear communication skills with the ability to present detailed execution and bug reports to stakeholders.



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Skills** 



* Exposure to Kubernetes for deploying, inspecting and debugging test environments.
* Experience with log analysis and monitoring stacks (ELK / Kibana, Grafana).
* Experience with additional automation frameworks and tools, including performance or load testing.
* Experience in desktop testing for Windows\-based applications.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Knowledge of Financial Markets / Trading.

title: QA Executive & Aquaculture Field Technician
description:
This job is provided by apna.co Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Raw Material Inspection


  Assess species, size, grade, freshness, and physical condition.
   

  

  Verify receiving temperature and condition of chilled/frozen materials.
   

  

  Ensure supplier/lot identification and traceability. Reject or hold materials that fail to meet specifications.
   

  

* Processing Monitoring


  Oversee washing, grading, deheading/peeling, freezing, and glazing. Verify product temperature at
   

  

 critical stages.
   

  

  Ensure compliance with SOPs and product specifications.
   

  

* HACCP \& Food Safety


  Monitor CCPs/OPRPs and critical limits.
   

  

  Record monitoring results and act immediately on deviations.
   

  

  Verify corrective actions and follow\-up measures.
   

  

* Personal Hygiene \& GMP


  Monitor worker hygiene and protective clothing.
   

  

  Ensure proper handwashing/sanitization practices.
   

  

  Enforce GMP and GHP standards in processing areas.
   

  

* Hazard Control


  Monitor cleaning and sanitation chemicals.
   

  

  Prevent chemical and foreign\-body contamination.
   

  

  Inspect equipment, utensils, and processing areas for hygiene.
   

  

* Finished Product Inspection


  Check appearance, colour, odour, texture, size/grade, weight, glazing, packaging, and labelling.
   

  

  Verify product against customer and internal specifications.
   

  

* Packaging \& Labelling


  Confirm correct packaging materials are used.
   

  

  Verify product details: name, species, grade, net weight, production/expiry dates, lot/batch number,
   

  

 storage instructions. Ensure compliance with customer\-specific requirements.
   

  

* Cold Chain Monitoring


  Monitor freezing, cold\-room, and dispatch temperatures.
   

  

  Ensure frozen products are maintained at ≤ −18°C.
   

  

  Record and report deviations.
   

  

* Traceability


  Maintain traceability from raw material to dispatch.
   

  

  Verify GRN, production, packing, and dispatch records.
   

  

* Non\-Conformance \& Corrective Action


  Identify and segregate non\-conforming products/processes.
   

  

  Raise NCRs and investigate root causes. Verify corrective/preventive actions.
   

  

* Documentation


  Maintain QC inspection records, CCP monitoring logs, temperature checks, sanitation reports, product
   

  

 inspection reports, calibration records, etc. Ensure records are complete, accurate, and audit\-ready.
   

  

* Field Aquaculture Supervision


  To travel to farm location in and around Alappuzha and collect and report aquaculture farm data
   

  

 weekly/monthly as per company requirements and report it to the respective teams.
   

  

  Provide technical support and ensure compliance with Best Aquaculture practise standards for Basa
   

  

 farming/ Shrimp farming/ other species. Supervise harvesting and dispatch operations.
   

  

  Maintain detailed records of farming activities and produce reports for each visit.
   

  

 Skills \& Attributes
   

  

  Basic computer and MS office skills.
   

  

  Analytical thinking and attention to detail.
   

  

  Strong communication skills, especially in explaining technical concepts to farmers.
   

  

  Adaptability to diverse field conditions and travel requirements.
   

  

  Ability to work independently and in teams.
   

  

  Relationship\-building and trust with aquaculture farmers and train them in aquaculture techniques
   

  

 during field visits.
